description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects an externally supplied successful client-certificate verification header on the affected initialization route.
affected_versions: Fortinet FortiClientEMS: 7.4.5 through 7.4.6; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects an externally supplied successful client-certificate verification header on the affected initialization route.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Trusted TLS terminators legitimately sending this header require a separate internal policy.
